purpose: Select an electronic-structure method using only non-kinetic calibration observables before any new production diffusion barrier is calculated.

known_but_forbidden_for_method_selection: Wong et al. 2005 STM diffusion barrier 75 +/- 5 meV
Wong et al. 2005 STM attempt frequency (5.3 +/- 0.4)e7 Hz
Kole et al. 2012 HeSE effective barrier 98 +/- 5 meV
Kole et al. 2012 Langevin-calibrated adiabatic barrier 123 meV
any published or subsequently obtained CO/Cu(111) diffusion coefficient, hopping rate, kinetic prefactor, fitted diffusion friction, or turnover quantity
allowed_calibration_classes: experimentally established low-coverage top-site adsorption preference
anti_circularity.absolute_adsorption_energy_role: held out from method selection in v0.1

pbe_site_problem.rule: PBE is still executed as the lowest-cost diagnostic candidate and may pass only if it satisfies every frozen gate; agreement with a kinetic barrier cannot rescue a failed site-ordering gate.

blyp_site_evidence.publication: Alaei et al., Phys. Rev. B 77, 085414 (2008)
blyp_site_evidence.role: published evidence that BLYP can recover the experimentally observed CO top-site preference on Cu(111) without fitting diffusion kinetics
blyp_site_evidence.pseudopotential_warning: the published work used home-made BLYP ultrasoft pseudopotentials validated against WIEN2K bulk calculations

hybrid_evidence.role: high-cost fallback/reference if no semilocal candidate passes
hybrid_evidence.qe_pseudopotential_rule: PBE-family pseudopotentials are permitted for PBE0/HSE-type hybrids only under the documented Quantum ESPRESSO hybrid-functional convention and after the exact files are pinned and tested

candidate_methods_ordered.pp_provenance_rule: No mixed PBE/BLYP production calculation is admissible. A BLYP Cu pseudopotential must be independently sourced or generated and validated before BLYP can enter the numerical method screen. C and O BLYP pseudopotentials are available in the legacy QE library, but that library is reference material and all files still require explicit validation and hashes.

candidate_methods_ordered.xc_pseudopotential_requirement: PBE-family pseudopotentials under QE hybrid convention
candidate_methods_ordered.trigger: execute only if PBE fails or is rejected and BLYP fails a physical gate, a pseudopotential-provenance gate, or a computational-feasibility gate

excluded_from_v0_1_production_candidate_.molecular_DFT_plus_U: excluded until the molecular subspace implementation and U value have independent provenance not derived from diffusion kinetics
excluded_from_v0_1_production_candidate_.RPA_or_correlated_wavefunction: benchmark evidence only unless a separately frozen compute/method amendment is adopted

bulk_joint_gate.note: inherits the already established numerical precision standard from the development-pilot engine; it is not fitted to CO/Cu(111) kinetics

cu_bulk_lattice.reference_type: experimental structural reference independent of diffusion kinetics
cu_bulk_lattice.role: broad substrate-fidelity guard, not a fitted target

gas_phase_CO_bond_length.reference_source: NIST CCCBDB experimental equilibrium bond length

adsorption_site_ordering.minimum_margin_rule: top must be lower than every competing site by more than two times the measured numerical site-energy sensitivity; no fixed kinetic-energy target is used

coverage_and_supercell_rule.holdout_role: post-selection non-kinetic coverage sensitivity for site ordering and adsorption geometry before production diffusion kinetics
coverage_and_supercell_rule.failure_action: increase the production supercell prospectively before any diffusion barrier is calculated; do not choose the size by barrier agreement

method_selection_algorithm.rule: Choose the lowest-cost candidate that passes every applicable pseudopotential-provenance, numerical-convergence, non-kinetic physical, and production-feasibility gate.

production_feasibility_gate.criterion: the selected method and pinned pseudopotential bundle must be capable of executing the registered adsorption screen, NEB/CI-NEB and Hessian stages without changing the electronic-structure method midstream
